issues.jp_before: 約束[やくそく]は{決[けっ]して|av-zenzen}忘[わす]れません。
issues.problem: Distractor とても is close to the natural とても忘れられない ('can never forget'), not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor とても with すっかり.

issues.jp_before: 三時間[さんじかん]待[ま]ったのに、{ちっとも/全然[ぜんぜん]|av-zenzen}順番[じゅんばん]が来[き]ません。
issues.problem: English 'my turn doesn't come at all' was unnatural.

issues.jp_before: 他[ほか]の人[ひと]には{決[けっ]して|av-zenzen}言[い]わないでください。
issues.problem: Distractor ぜひ + ないでください is heard in casual speech as an emphatic request, so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor ぜひ with すっかり.

issues.jp_before: スーパーの魚[さかな]は{あまり|av-zenzen}新[あたら]しくなかった。
issues.problem: 新しい for fish freshness is colloquial; 新鮮 is the standard word.
issues.action: Changed to 新鮮[しんせん]じゃなかった, lv 5 -> 3.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]の近[ちか]くを探[さが]しましたが、財布[さいふ]は全然[ぜんぜん]{見[み]つかりませんでした|av-zenzen}。
issues.problem: English 'my wallet wasn't found at all' was unnatural.
issues.action: Rewrote English: 'I couldn't find my wallet anywhere.'

issues.jp_before: 先輩[せんぱい]に聞[き]いても、ちっとも{教[おし]えてくれない|av-zenzen}。
issues.problem: English assumed the senior's gender ('he') and was awkward.
issues.action: Rewrote English with 'they ... anything at all'.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]はお酒[さけ]をあまり{飲[の]みません|av-zenzen}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of コーヒーはあまり飲みません and of the 母は料理を item (same verb and subject pattern).
issues.action: Rewrote as このかばんは最近あまり使っていません with matching distractors.
